hand_computed: N, n, the decision-point counts and LOC are counted by hand from the file; V, G, MI and the band are re-derived by scripts/mi_reference.py and checked by scripts/validate_mi_definition.py
notes: LOC == 1, so ln(LOC) == 0: legal, and the top of the reachable range. The tail expression `a + b` has no `;`, so it is not an expression_statement and adds no line: a one-line function is one logical line. `add` is a definition name, so it is an operand.
